tasks.name: 홈 장르·추천 UI 개선
tasks.summary: HomeScreen now shows all genres joined with · and keeps the empty-genre fallback. TOP 3 posters are 84×118 with tighter spacing for text. The featured hero responds to horizontal swipes using its measured width and stays in sync with the number buttons. Checks passed: typecheck, test (17/17), export.

tasks.name: 가로 포스터 종류와 캠페인 시드 추가
tasks.summary: Added POSTER_LANDSCAPE with a reversible DB constraint migration and storage-key mapping. Seed data now gives each drama a landscape-poster record referencing its HOME_HERO file and adds an active HOME_CAMPAIGN featuring the romance drama. Updated tests and the content-image model documentation. Lint, tests (31 passed), and build passed.

tasks.name: 가로 포스터 API 응답 연결
